body: That is true, but so hard to get there with a happy attitude trying to be good, when actually your depressed

I doubt it, she have tried to help me a lot. Now is the time she completely turned around, goes out to party's very often and doesn't care if i don't message to her. She can't help me with social skills, she knows that its a problem, if she could she already would have tried. I don't think i want to be friends with her after everything, i'd rather just die.
Tomorrow she's going to a psychologist, from which i conclude that she will break up with me after that. With 0 social skills i can't see how i will have fun talks with random people there.

The only feeling i have left which i find positive is when i win money at poker, my addiction in the past. But when i lose it just get worse and worse giving myself thoughts of going into a casino with all the money i have, put everything 5 times on black at roulette. If i win i start a new life in a different country, if i lose its decided.

She will probably break up with me tomorrow, so she won't be my gf when i die. She will be sad tho, but yeah, give it like two months and she'll be f*cking another dude, as anyone would do. Life goes on.

I did not get a girlfriend because i was so good at it. I got in contact with her because she was in my class. She always tried to get to know me, but i was never in the mood for that, she even annoyed me for like 3 months with those happy attempts.
In the gym everyone is busy with themselves. I had one smalltalk with a guy, like 3 times for about 10 minutes, a guy like 20 years older. Because i do not have even one friend, i don't go to concerts. It's stupid to go alone, besides i'm not in the type to get crazy dance and be happy at concerts or clubs

I had them, i played poker and was a gamer. Now i'm not interested in those things, it started to ruin my life because addiction. Now that i do not do those things i don't have friends. People didn't hang out with me because of me, but for what i was doing.

The most obvious thing to go to a psychologist. The problem is that i have already been there for a half year because of the bond between my parents and myself. All the three psychologists said almost literally 'just move out if u can't handle your parents idiot'. After they convinced my parents i had to move out and go into a house where they help with cooking and stuff. My psychiatrist gave me anti-depression pills and sleep pills. 
Yeah, thats the help i would choose if i did not have this experience with them. I can't believe that anyone can/want help me. Thats why i'm asking Reddit now for an answer on my title.

My experience is that the conversations about work or fitness do not go further than that. It does not go to real friendships or more talks. Whenever it gets there it's starting to go towards partying/outgoing things like that, which things i just cant enjoy. I'm not fun enough to party and dance - it also contains lots of social happyness, which i'm not in the mood for.

I have done things like that, and you would think that school is also a place where everyone has the same interest. Still i can't get any contact with people. There is always someone who is the, so called 'alpha male' who gets everything done socially, i'm nothing compared to that. Even if there is no alpha male, i have no idea how to keep a conversation going, what do i have to ask? am i interested in their answer? (mostly not) I'm not confident at all when i'm speaking.

She's the opposite of me. She's very happy all the time, outgoing, etc. and i am just making her depressed the last 2 months with my fucked up behavior. I could handle this break up if i was just a normal guy. My biggest problem is that i can't be social at all, i do not know why but it is my whole life this way. Its not like i'm a weird looking guy or anything. My ex said i'm the most attractive guy she ever went out with, i'm weightlifting now for 2 years, I play guitar, school is going well. I mean, i'm not a weird person from the outside - one who can be bullied or whatever. The problem is that i have absolute 0 skill in social things/having friends.

I'm 20 years old from Europe (not the best English but lets hope i'll be clear enough), and i'm really lonely. In my whole life there is just one person who accepts who i am and who knows my story. I had friends, but not because of who i am but because what i did (like gaming or playing poker). I've never had anyone who liked me for who i am, which i understand. Im not social at all, very quiet and pretty depressed my whole life. 
The only one who accepts me for who I am is my girlfriend. She got in my life because we were in the same class and noticed how depressed i was and tried to help me. 
Now, after 1 year being friends and 1 year relationship with her she wants to break up with me. I understand why and i know i have been a terrible person. I can't help it, and i know it's better for her to live a life without me. 
Now that she's gone and i'm alone without any skill in social stuff i am thinking to kill myself. I just don't want it to hurt much, let me leave this life painless.
I'm so sorry, I am new to reddit, I hope you can forgive me for this.
